_comment: chirp airband daemon defaults. Phase 4a defaults + Phase 4b 'sdr' block. 'sdr' is consulted only when CHIRP_SOURCE=sdr (or source='sdr' here). All keys are optional and can be overridden by the matching CHIRP_* env var. See chirp/config/README.md.

sdr._comment: SDR source defaults for airband. Revision 4.0 (arrangement C, M1, macOS, 2026-07-08): airband AM runs on the RTL-SDR Blog V4 (serial 83241970) via gr-osmosdr's native 'rtl=' backend — exactly like ground, NOT Soapy/SDRplay. The RSP is digital-only now (SDRTrunk), so chirp never touches it and the historical Soapy/apiService airband corruption is out of the picture entirely. STATUS pending-soak: airband-AM-on-RTL is proven by lineage (rtl_airband ran Nashville airband AM on RTLs for years) and by composition (chirp-on-RTL is proven on ground; chirp AM demod is proven), but this exact combo hasn't been soaked under the current chirp engine — flip the device status to validated after a clean soak. No bandwidth_hz needed for RTL (0 = driver default). center_freq_hz is retuned by the LO scheduler to cover the airband list (the RTL's ~2.4 MHz window, hopped just as on the RSP). The Blog V4's R828D + TCXO front end is excellent for airband.
